title: Correction or retraction notice
description: A published notice that names what was wrong and what is right, where and when the error ran, and who corrected it. A retraction withdraws the story. Do not repeat the false claim as a headline. Outlet and people are fictional.

publisher.description: Outlet or organization issuing the notice (fictional)

issuedAt.description: Date and time of the notice

examples: Correction: video of the plant fire was filmed in 2022

original.description: Where and when the error ran
examples: A web article and a push alert published at 5:42 PM ET on November 4.

wasWrong.description: What was wrong, stated once, plainly
examples: The article said a video showed a fire at the Halyard Components plant on Tuesday.
The video was filmed at a different facility in 2022. There was no fire at the plant on Tuesday.

actionTaken.description: What was done: removed, updated, notified
examples: The video was removed from the article and the push alert was withdrawn.
